name: MindSparkle
tagline: Chat-first AI study companion for any document — summaries, quizzes, presentations, guides, and study packs.
description: MindSparkle opens with a polished welcome, then a focused chat workspace. Upload PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, or CSV, switch modes from the side rail (Summarize, Quiz, Presentation, Guide, Study), ask follow-up questions, and export results.
